title: Mountain lake at sunrise, static wide
prompt: A mountain lake at sunrise with thin mist drifting across the surface and mirror reflections of snow peaks. Static camera, wide shot. 24 mm lens, soft pink and gold morning light, a touch of lens flare on the ridge. Serene, cold-morning atmosphere.
why: Drifting mist and a mirror reflection are two slow, large-scale motions that read well in a wide static shot. The pink-gold light names a palette so the model does not default to noon.

title: Coastal dune, tilt down
prompt: Tall grass on a coastal dune bending in gusts of wind, grey waves rolling in behind it. Slow tilt down from the clouds to the grass. 50 mm lens, overcast silver light, muted palette. Moody, wild atmosphere.
why: Tilt down from clouds to grass gives the move a start and an end. Grass bending in gusts is a texture motion the model renders well; waves behind add depth.

title: Autumn pond, push in
prompt: Autumn leaves falling slowly from a maple tree onto a still forest pond, ripples spreading where they land. Slow push in toward the water. 85 mm lens, soft backlit afternoon sun with rays through the branches, amber and rust palette. Gentle, melancholic mood.
why: Falling leaves plus spreading ripples is cause and effect in one frame, which makes the physics legible. Backlit rays through branches are named to justify the warm palette.

title: Thunderstorm over a plain, with sound
prompt: A storm front moving over a flat grassland, dark clouds rolling forward, a single lightning strike far on the horizon, grass flattening in the gusts. Static wide shot from a low angle. 24 mm lens, late afternoon light under the cloud edge. Audio: rising wind, distant thunder after the strike, rain starting to hit the lens at the very end. No music.
why: Audio has a timeline here (strike, then thunder, then rain) and Veo can follow it when the visual order matches. Keeping the strike 'far on the horizon' avoids the over-bright flash that ruins exposure.

title: Tide pool, macro
prompt: A tide pool at low tide: a red anemone slowly opening its tentacles, small bubbles rising, sunlight rippling on the sandy bottom. Static camera, macro, anemone centred. 100 mm macro lens, bright overhead daylight, caustic light patterns. Calm, curious mood.
why: Caustics and an opening anemone are both slow and continuous, so nothing has to start or stop inside the clip. 'Static camera' keeps the macro focus from hunting.
